Jul 29, 2022 • Less than a minute read

Our collaboration study titled "Prediction of Five-Year Cardiovascular Disease Risk in People with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus - Derivation in Nanjing, China and External Validation in Scotland, UK", led by [Cheng Wan](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Cheng-Wan-3) from Nanjing Medical University, has been published by [Global Heart](https://globalheartjournal.com/article/10.5334/gh.1131/). This study shows it is feasible to generate a risk prediction model using routinely collected Chinese hospital data. This indicates there is a great potential to make use of the large-scale and relatively easy accessible route data for identifying those at risk of CVD and help significantly improve CVD prevention in people with diabetes.

Cheng Wan, Steph Read, Honghan Wu, Shan Lu, Xin Zhang, Sarah H. Wild, and Yun Liu. Prediction of Five-Year Cardiovascular Disease Risk in People with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: Derivation in Nanjing, China and External Validation in Scotland, UK. Global Heart. 2022;17(1):46. DOI: 10.5334/gh.1131.
